items.title: Does the Oleshky ceasefire signal progress to come in Ukraine?
items.teaser: Hundreds of civilians were evacuated from the city of Oleshky after Russia and Ukraine agreed to a US-brokered ceasefire. Some observers have expressed optimism that more such humanitarian missions might follow.

items.title: Achievements and challenges ahead — Commander-in-Chief Drapatyi's 100 days in office
items.teaser: Major General Mykhailo Drapatyi marked 100 days as commander-in-chief of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in late October, as Ukraine regains ground in the northern part of Donetsk Oblast and seeks to improve defensive positions before winter. Drapatyi, one of Ukraine's most popular generals, was appointed in July with

items.title: Pro-Russian Latvian moves to Russia, gets forcibly conscripted into the Russian army
items.teaser: While in pre-trial detention, Sergei Mulivanov signed a military contract and was subsequently sent to participate in the Russian invasion he had previously vocally supported.

items.title: Lubinets presents Melania Trump with Order of Princess Olga
items.teaser: Ukrainian Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets personally presented U.S. First Lady Melania Trump with the Order of Princess Olga, awarded to her for her significant contribution to humanitarian support for Ukraine.

items.title: Meloni warns of need for dedicated EU envoy to avoid 'condemning Europe to irrelevance' in peace talks
items.teaser: "I am convinced that we all realize how, by giving the image of a Europe that is proceeding in disarray, we are doing nothing but serving the interests of those who want this war to continue. And I think it is unacceptable, given that human lives and the future of our security are at stake," Italian Prime Minister Gior

items.title: Was wird aus Trumps Diesel-Deal mit Russland?
items.teaser: ZDFheute live analysiert mit dem Militärexperten Nico Lange die aktuelle Lage in der Ukraine und blickt nach den Midterms auf Trumps umstrittenen Diesel-Deal mit Russland.

items.title: The US blue wave is not blue and yellow — yet
items.teaser: The results of the 2026 U.S. midterm elections have brought the Democratic Party a largely anticipated, if nonetheless remarkable in scale, victory. Democrats have outperformed even the most optimistic expectations, dramatically shifting the balance of power in Washington in their favor. With the coalition that brought

items.title: Zelenskyy hopes for increased US support following midterm elections
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy hopes that following the US midterm elections, the balance of power will stabilise and Ukraine will receive more support.

items.title: Zelensky invites Ibero-American Summit countries to join Drone Deal cooperation format
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has invited countries participating in the Ibero-American Summit to cooperate with Ukraine under the Drone Deal format, including through joint drone production and technology sharing.

items.title: Ukraine, Russia share stage at Melania Trump's event, only Kyiv calls for more Oleshky-style missions
items.teaser: "We would like you to keep going and find new missions and de-escalate as much as possible," David Arakhamia, the head of President Volodymyr Zelensky's parliamentary group, told the first lady. "Your mission is above politics."

items.title: Ukrainian woman dies in illegal Russian detention in Crimea
items.teaser: Oleksandra Kazarovytska, who was 44 years old, had returned to occupied Sevastopol to help her parents sell their apartment, according to the statement of the Kharkiv language school where she served as director of studies.

items.title: Russian forces attack manufacturing facility in Kyiv Oblast, injuring two people
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a manufacturing and warehouse facility in Kyiv Oblast on 5 November, injuring two people and damaging nearby buildings.

items.title: Zelensky urges Latin American countries and Spain to help restore Ukraine's energy system
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has called on Latin American countries and Spain to urgently help supply Ukraine with transformers, cables, generators and other electrical equipment to restore its energy system following Russian attacks.

items.title: Ukrainian businesses allowed to share air defence systems and protect each other's facilities
items.teaser: The Ukrainian government has allowed businesses with their own air defence groups to protect other companies' facilities under contracts.

items.title: Oleshky’s evacuation was called a success, but some residents didn’t make it out. Now, the aid is still not reaching them
items.teaser: Some people hid in basements without a signal and never learned there was a way out, the town’s Ukrainian administration says.

items.title: Senior Ukrainian law enforcement officials charged in sprawling scam call centers case
items.teaser: Accoridng to Ukraine's anti-corruption agencies, the group was also involved in torture-for-hire, kidnappings, extorting millions of dollars, and other crimes.

items.title: Video zeigt russischen Drohnenangriff auf Feuerwehrleute während eines laufenden Löscheinsatzes in Slowjansk
items.teaser: In der Stadt Slowjansk im Gebiet Donezk hat eine russische Drohne Feuerwehrleute angegriffen, während diese einen durch russischen Beschuss verursachten Brand löschen.

items.title: Finnisches Gericht verurteilt Kapitän aus Russland und ein weiteres Besatzungsmitglied wegen Sabotage an Ostseekabeln: 1,9 Millionen Euro Strafe
items.teaser: Ende 2025 haben Unbekannte wichtige Tiefseekabel in der Ostsee beschädigt. Die finnische Regierung nahm ein Schiff mit russischem Kapitän ins Visier. Jetzt wurde der verurteilt.

items.title: Ukrainian and Slovak PMs agree on establishment of bilingual schools
items.teaser: During a visit to Lviv, Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico and Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi signed an intergovernmental Agreement on establishing bilingual gymnasiums in both countries.

items.title: Melania Trump delivers personal letters to Zelenskyy and Putin through Ukrainian MP and Russian envoy
items.teaser: US First Lady Melania Trump has delivered personal letters to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Russian leader Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Hungarian Foreign Ministry considers Ukraine's EU accession by 2030 unrealistic
items.teaser: Hungarian Foreign Minister Anita Orbán has stated that Budapest does not consider Ukraine's accession to the European Union by 2030 to be realistic, ruling out any accelerated process.

items.title: Security guarantees for Ukraine top agenda of talks in Brussels – Umerov
items.teaser: Security guarantees for Ukraine and a new European security strategy were the main topics of meetings in Brussels on November 5 with representatives of France, the United Kingdom, Germany, the United States and NATO.

items.title: Ukraine: Korruption und Mafiastrukturen bei Geheimdienst und Polizei?
items.teaser: Ukrainische Antikorruptionsbehörden haben neue Ermittlungsergebnisse veröffentlicht, die schockieren: Der Korruptionsskandal zieht offenbar noch weitere Kreise als bisher bekannt - und betrifft auch Geheimdienst und Polizei. Von F. Kellermann.

items.title: Slovakia to provide Ukraine with 54 generators, funds for shelters and medical equipment
items.teaser: Slovakia will provide Ukraine with an energy assistance package, including 54 generators, as well as funds for the Civil Protection Shelter Coalition and medical equipment.

items.title: Koretskyi, Fico sign Ukraine-Slovakia cooperation agreement in Lviv
items.teaser: Ukraine and Slovakia have signed a joint declaration on cooperation setting out all existing practical agreements and planned projects.

items.title: Security guarantees for Ukraine discussed with US and European officials in Brussels
items.teaser: Representatives of Ukraine, the US, France, the UK, Germany, and NATO have held a working meeting in Brussels to discuss future security guarantees.

items.title: Deutschland hat seit Kriegsbeginn 36 Tausend Energiegüter an Ukraine übergeben
items.teaser: Seit Beginn der Vollinvasion Russlands haben deutsche Unternehmen den ukrainischen Energieversorgern über 36.000 Energiegüter zur Unterstützung beim Wiederaufbau der Energieinfrastruktur bereitgestellt, teilt das ukrainische Energieministerium auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Five suspects in Carthage case notified of charges, including senior SBU and National Police officials
items.teaser: Detectives from the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) have notified five alleged members of a criminal organization of suspicion. The organization was exposed the previous day as part of Operation Carthage.

items.title: Emergency power outages introduced in Dnipro, scheduled cuts suspended
items.teaser: Emergency power outages have been introduced in the city of Dnipro by order of Ukrenergo, meaning hourly scheduled power cuts are currently suspended.

items.title: Police find missing woman alive four days after Russian bombing of Komyshuvakha underground school. Death toll rises to 43.
items.teaser: Russia dropped multiple aerial bombs, including a three-ton FAB-3000, on an underground school in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, while civilians gathered to receive humanitarian aid. At least 43 people were killed.

items.title: Zelensky, Costa discuss preparations for Abu Dhabi meeting, Ukraine's EU integration
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and European Council President Antonio Costa have discussed the possibility of completing all negotiating clusters on Ukraine's EU accession by the end of this year and moving on to closing individual negotiating chapters next year.

items.title: Fico downplays prospect of Slovakia hosting peace talks during Lviv visit
items.teaser: Fico's latest comments seemingly downplay the suggestion made by his foreign minister, Juraj Blanar, who proposed Bratislava as a venue for preparatory peace talks after his visit to Moscow last week.

items.title: Three more Russian commanders served with notices of suspicion over Okhmatdyt missile strike
items.teaser: Ukrainian law enforcement has served notices of suspicion in absentia on three more Russian commanders involved in the deadly missile strike on the Okhmatdyt children's hospital in Kyiv.

items.title: US Democrats planning to investigate Musk's actions over Starlink throttling for Ukraine, CNN reports
items.teaser: The US Senate Foreign Relations Committee has sent letters to Elon Musk to preserve documents ahead of a planned investigation into the throttling of Starlink in Ukraine.

items.title: Russen haben 2185 Kulturstätten in der Ukraine seit Kriegsbeginn beschädigt
items.teaser: Bis Ende Oktober sind in der Ukraine 2185 Kulturstätten infolge der russischen Aggression beschädigt worden.

items.title: Zelensky on new EUR 4.36B EU tranche: Funds will go toward energy, air defense, drones
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky thanked the European Union for allocating EUR 4.36 billion to Ukraine and said the funds would be used to strengthen the energy sector and air defenses and to purchase drones and electronic warfare equipment.

items.title: Police, SBU identify 130 people potentially involved in clashes near National Guard facility in Kyiv Oblast
items.teaser: Of the 130 people identified, 27 allegedly "took an active part in unlawful actions," while another 24 "acted aggressively, incited others, and deliberately provoked confrontations" with police and National Guard personnel, according to the National Police.

items.title: Notice of suspicion served on woman, 22, who tried to overturn National Guard bus during clashes in Kyiv Oblast
items.teaser: A 22-year-old woman involved in the unrest in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka, Kyiv Oblast, has been served with a notice of suspicion for obstructing the Armed Forces.

items.title: Mitglied der Schattenflotte?: Kapitän nach Kabel-Sabotage in der Ostsee verurteilt
items.teaser: Seit dem Beginn des Ukraine-Kriegs ist auch die Ostsee Schauplatz des Konflikts. Immer wieder werden wichtige Kabel und Leitungen beschädigt. Nun hat Finnland zwei Seeleute wegen Sabotage zu mehrjährigen Haftstrafen verurteilt.

items.title: Mathernova urges Ukraine to speed up reforms, warns EU enlargement 'window of opportunity' may close
items.teaser: Ukraine's Verkhovna Rada should speed up the adoption of necessary reforms, as the current "window of opportunity" for Ukraine to advance towards EU membership will not remain open indefinitely.

items.title: HACC remands senior National Police official Tsenov in custody, sets bail at UAH 15M
items.teaser: Ukraine's High Anti-Corruption Court (HACC) has ordered Volodymyr Tsenov, First Deputy Head of the Strategic Investigations Department of the National Police of Ukraine, to be held in custody, with the option of posting bail set at UAH 15 million.

items.title: Inside Republican watch parties, some blame midterm failure on Trump's unkept promises — including Ukraine
items.teaser: WASHINGTON, United States — "It is a funeral," a conservative voter from South Carolina said, gesturing toward the crowd inside the Butterworth, a restaurant in the heart of Washington that has long been favored by members and supporters of the Republican Party. It is where Washington Republicans come

items.title: Zelensky discusses return of Ukrainian children abducted by Russia with Andorran PM
items.teaser: In Madrid, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed joint efforts to bring back Ukrainian children abducted by Russia with Andorran Prime Minister Xavier Espot Zamora.

items.title: Crimea’s lights go out again—and Ukraine says two more Pantsirs were hit
items.teaser: Russia’s Energy Ministry claims a Ukrainian attack cut Crimea’s power on 4 November—the second straight night the peninsula lost supply.

items.title: Selenskyj: Zahl der Toten nach russischem Angriff auf Komyschuwacha steigt auf 43
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Toten nach einem russischen Angriff auf das Dorf Komyschuwacha im Gebiet Saporischschja ist auf 43 gestiegen.

items.title: Ukraine's anti-corruption court orders probe into prominent Zelensky ally
items.teaser: When asked about the corruption allegations, David Arakhamia, head of President Volodymyr Zelensky's parliamentary faction, told the Kyiv Independent that he "hadn't had time to look into the matter."

items.title: EU überweist Ukraine 4,36 Milliarden Euro für Stärkung finanzieller Resilienz
items.teaser: Die Europäische Kommission hat der Ukraine eine weitere Tranche von 4,36 Milliarden Euro im Rahmen des Unterstützungsdarlehens Ukraine Support Loan überwiesen, das für die Jahre 2026-2027 vorgesehen ist.

items.title: A Kyiv-bound Shahed carried a warhead and leaflets touting a “Ukrainian” brigade in Russia’s army
items.teaser: Ukrainian troops downed it on 4 November. A second leaflet in the bundle attacked Ukraine’s military recruitment offices.

items.title: Woman reported missing after Russian attack on Komyshuvakha found alive
items.teaser: A 56-year-old woman who had been reported missing following a Russian attack on Komyshuvakha has been found alive.

items.title: Water supply disruptions return in Kyiv, metro service temporarily suspended due to power fluctuations
items.teaser: Kyivvodokanal, the municipal utility responsible for water supply and wastewater services in Kyiv and the surrounding region, said at around 1:30 p.m. local time that power outages at its facilities had disrupted water supplies across all districts of the capital.

items.title: Kharkiv teacher dies in pre-trial detention centre in occupied Crimea
items.teaser: Oleksandra Kazarovytska was detained in Sevastopol after travelling to Crimea to help her parents. Russian occupation authorities claim she took her own life.

items.title: EU allocates nearly EUR 1B for winter support of Ukraine's energy sector – Mathernova
items.teaser: The European Union has earmarked nearly EUR 1 billion to support Ukraine's energy sector this winter.

items.title: Head of Zelenskyy's Office Budanov on high-profile corruption revelations involving law enforcement officials: Decisive action needed
items.teaser: Head of Ukraine's President's Office Kyrylo Budanov calls for decisive action following corruption revelations involving senior law enforcement officials in Operation Carthage.

items.title: Das sagt Selenskyj bei Böhmermann über Elon Musk
items.teaser: Jan Böhmermann hat mit dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Selenskyj gesprochen. Sein ungewöhnlicher Weg vom Comedian zum Präsidenten, die Midterms in den USA und Elon Musk waren Thema.

items.title: EU divided over "associate membership" idea that Germany's Merz proposed for Ukraine, Politico says
items.teaser: Germany keeps pushing "associate member" status for Ukraine while von der Leyen floats the term for Canada, deepening a rift between Berlin and Brussels, Politico says.

items.title: Litwinenko-Witwe: "Der Westen hat einen großen Fehler gemacht"
items.teaser: Vor 20 Jahren wurde der russische Ex-Agent Litwinenko in London vergiftet. Seine Witwe treibt heute vor allem eins um: Hat der Westen mit seiner zaghaften Reaktion damals Putins heutige Aggression ermutigt? Von Mareike Aden.

items.title: Zivile und kritische Infrastruktur in Region Winnyzja bei russischem Angriff beschädigt, es gibt Verletzte
items.teaser: In mehreren Gemeinden der Region Winnyzja wurden am 5. November durch einen russischen Angriff zivile und kritische Infrastruktur beschädigt, drei Personen wurden verletzt.

items.title: Putin places Japanese company's assets under "temporary management"
items.teaser: Following moves against European brands such as Metro and Auchan, Moscow has placed JTI's Russian assets under the state-managed entity Promyslovye Aktivy.

items.title: Death toll from Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha rises to 43 – Zelensky
items.teaser: The death toll from a Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha in the Zaporizhzhia region has risen to 43.

items.title: The Expiry of MINURSO’s Mandate, Western Sahara, and the Foundations of International Law
items.teaser: Last Friday, on 30 October 2026, the UN Security Council failed to renew the mandate of the UN’s Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO), bringing to an end an international presence that has lasted since 1991. In terms of immediate consequences, this could have considerable ramifications on the ground,

items.title: Selenskyj bei Böhmermann: "Es muss ein würdevolles Ende sein"
items.teaser: Im ZDF-Interview spricht Selenskyj über US-Unterstützung, Elon Musk und seine Hoffnung auf ein würdiges Ende des Kriegs mit Russland.

items.title: Russian drone attacks firefighters while they battle blaze in Sloviansk
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked firefighters with a drone while they were extinguishing a fire in Sloviansk.

items.title: Russen greifen erneut Energieobjekte an, in Kyjiw und vier Regionen Stromausfälle gemeldet
items.teaser: Nach dem russischen Drohnen- und Raketenangriff wurden am Montag dem 5. November in der Hauptstadt Kyjiw und vier Regionen der Ukraine Stromausfälle gemeldet.

items.title: Water supply disruptions reported across all districts of Kyiv due to power outages
items.teaser: Emergency power outages have caused disruptions to water supply in all districts of Kyiv.

items.title: Russian milblogger urges hitting Ukraine’s nuclear plants. ISW: without stronger defenses, last winter will likely repeat
items.teaser: Ukraine’s nuclear plants have already cut output because the damaged grid cannot carry their power.

items.title: Lithuania's Foreign Ministry summons Russian diplomat over attacks on Ukraine
items.teaser: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Lithuania summoned a representative of the Russian Embassy to condemn attacks on civilian facilities and critical infrastructure in Ukraine.

items.title: Schäden an Unterseekabeln in der Ostsee: Urteil gegen russischen Kapitän
items.teaser: Zehn Monate nach der Sabotage an zwei Kabeln in der Ostsee sind ein russischer Kapitän und ein Crewmitglied in Finnland zu mehrjährigen Haftstrafen verurteilt worden. Sie sollen die Unterseekabel vorsätzlich mit einem Anker beschädigt haben.

items.title: Lived in occupation, fought against Ukraine. Now, Kyiv says, Russia won’t take them back.
items.teaser: Kyiv says it would trade those who ask to go to Russia for Ukrainian defenders. Moscow claims it just won back 50 such men.

items.title: Russian forces strike civilian and critical infrastructure in Vinnytsia region, injuring three
items.teaser: Several communities in Ukraine's Vinnytsia region sustained damage to civilian and critical infrastructure during a Russian attack on November 5. Three people were reported injured.

items.title: Water supply problems reported across Kyiv
items.teaser: Emergency power cuts caused water supply problems in every Kyiv district; Kyivvodokanal says supply is gradually being restored and pump kiosks are available.

items.title: A record EU assessment despite stalled reforms: what's behind Brussels' optimism on Ukraine
items.teaser: Brussels believes that Ukrainian MPs will come to their senses and realise that, through their actions and inaction, Ukraine is allowing Moldova to overtake it on the path to EU membership.

items.title: Police identify 130 participants in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka clashes – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian law enforcement identifies 130 individuals linked to clashes in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka, citing 27 active rioters and 24 aggressive provocateurs.

items.title: Defense Forces strike Russian attack drone launch site, military depots
items.teaser: On November 4 and overnight into November 5, units of Ukraine's Defense Forces struck a launch site for attack drones, Russian military depots, enemy mobile fire groups and repair units.

items.title: Russian attacks kill nine civilians in Kherson, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Sumy oblasts in a day
items.teaser: Bombs and drones hit homes across front-line communities, while the death toll from Monday's strike on an aid point in Komyshuvakha kept rising.

items.title: Geheimdienst: 15 von 38 wichtigsten russischen Ölraffinerien außer Betrieb bis Ende September
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Streitkräfte haben bis Ende September 15 von 38 wichtigsten russischen Ölraffinerien außer Betrieb gesetzt.

items.title: Spionage für Russland? - Mehrere Festnahmen in Polen gemeldet
items.teaser: Polnische Ermittler haben mehrere Menschen unter dem Verdacht der Agententätigkeit für Russland festgenommen.

items.title: Zelensky: Increased US aid can force Putin to reconsider plans to continue war
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky hopes that a Democratic victory in the U.S. midterm elections will lead to increased American military and financial assistance for Ukraine. He believes this could influence Putin's decision on whether to continue the war and bring peace negotiations closer.

items.title: Razzien in drei Regionen: Polens Geheimdienst nimmt mutmaßliche russische Agenten fest
items.teaser: Sechs mutmaßliche Agenten sollen für Russland in Polen Waffenkomponenten beschafft haben. Der polnische Inlandsgeheimdienst fasst sie während einer großangelegten Operation. Vier der Verdächtigen wird auch Spionage vorgeworfen.

items.title: Ukraine receives €4.36bn from EU after adopting reforms
items.teaser: Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi has said Ukraine received €4.36 billion from the EU, including €3.7 billion in macro-financial aid and €660 million for defence.

items.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine’s drug supply chain leave pharmacy shelves empty
items.teaser: Ukrainians last saw pharmacy shelves this empty in the first weeks of Russia’s full-scale invasion in 2022.

items.title: Russian forces strike Hlukhiv with drone, two injured
items.teaser: Russian forces have carried out a drone strike on the city of Hlukhiv in Sumy region, injuring a 51-year-old woman and a 16-year-old girl.

items.title: Ukrainian, Azerbaijani ministers meet in Uzhhorod for energy talks
items.teaser: Ukrainian and Azerbaijani government delegations are set to hold bilateral on Nov. 5, involving business representatives from both countries.

items.title: Man takes woman hostage in Ternopil store, shots fired, suspect arrested
items.teaser: Special forces officers from the KORD tactical response unit in Ternopil have arrested an armed man who had locked a store manager inside an office.

items.title: EU disburses over 4 billion euros in budget support to Ukraine
items.teaser: The EU's Economy Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis described the payment as "an investment in Ukraine’s recovery, security and prosperity, and in its future as a member of the European Union."

items.title: Russian attacks kill 9, injure 19 across Ukraine over past day, as casualty toll from Russian strikes in Kherson Oblast rises following end of ceasefire
items.teaser: Beyond Kherson Oblast, Russian forces launched two guided missiles from the Black Sea and 128 long-range attack drones at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 5, including 65 jet-powered drones, the Air Force said.

items.title: Finland court jails captain and crew member over Baltic cable sabotage
items.teaser: Finland seized the Fitburg freighter last year over the suspected sabotage of cables linking Helsinki and Tallinn. It's one of several incidents of damaged infrastructure in the Baltic since Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: Finnish court jails Russian captain of Fitburg for damaging underwater cables
items.teaser: Helsinki court sentenced Russian captain Andrei Maksimenko to three and a half years in prison and boatswain Vusal Majidov to nearly three for dragging an anchor and cutting cables.

items.title: Train services on one of Kyiv's metro lines suspended
items.teaser: Train services on the red line of the Kyiv Metro have been temporarily suspended due to significant voltage fluctuations in the power grid.

items.title: Humanitarian aid reportedly not reaching residents in occupied Oleshky community – Military Administration
items.teaser: There are reports that humanitarian aid left for residents of the temporarily occupied Oleshky community is not reaching those in need.

items.title: 42 bodies recovered from rubble after Russian strike on Komyshuvakha as search continues, police say
items.teaser: With the final death toll yet to be officially established, the strike on the front-line village is already one of the deadliest single Russian attacks since the start of the full-scale invasion four and a half years ago.

items.title: Drohnenangriff auf Rjasan: Eine der größten Raffinerie Russlands und Lager von Wildberries stehen in Flammen
items.teaser: In der russischen Stadt Rjasan brennt nach einem Drohnenangriff eine lokale Ölraffinerie.

items.title: A Ukrainian ground robot hauls up to 500 kg—and tows broken robots back for repair
items.teaser: Its maker says the robot has been tested in combat and is heading for military approval, as Russian drone units hunt Ukraine's robotic supply runs.

items.title: Ukrainian forces rendered 15 of 38 main Russian oil refineries inoperable
items.teaser: Attacks by Ukrainian forces have shut down 15 major Russian refineries and forced 12 others to cut production, triggering domestic fuel supply shortages.

items.title: Defense Forces put 15 of Russia's 38 major oil refineries out of operation in late September – Intelligence
items.teaser: As of late September, Ukraine's Defense Forces had put 15 of Russia's 38 major oil refineries out of operation.

items.title: At least 100 satellites, fast but maybe not as fast as Starlink: a Ukrainian firm sizes up a satellite network for Ukraine’s military
items.teaser: Its CEO says the timeline hinges on launch queues and scarce ground terminals, and later stages could cost far more than the privately funded test satellite.

items.title: South Korea tests Arctic shipping route amid Russia-West row
items.teaser: For South Korean ships, navigating off north coast of Russia dramatically reduces travel time to Europe, but the pro-Ukraine coalition might see it as undermining their efforts to isolate Moscow.

items.title: Komyschuwacha: Zahl der Todesopfer auf 42 gestiegen – Sucharbeiten dauern an
items.teaser: In Komyschuwacha dauern die Rettungsmaßnahmen bereits den vierten Tag an.

items.title: US Congress to initiate impeachment of Pentagon chief next week – CNN
items.teaser: Kentucky Republican Representative Thomas Massie plans to trigger a House vote to impeach Pete Hegseth, accusing him of escalating the Iran conflict without an exit strategy.

items.title: Two police officers injured in drone attack near Komyshuvakha die in hospital
items.teaser: On 1 November, a Russian drone struck a police vehicle near Komyshuvakha in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, seriously injuring two police officers, Oleh Dubetskyi and Serhii Berezhko. Despite doctors' efforts, both officers have subsequently died.

items.title: Death toll from airstrike on Komyshuvakha rises to 42, search operations continue
items.teaser: The death toll in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, following a Russian airstrike has risen to 42.

items.title: Russen töten vier Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Die russischen Angreifer haben am 4. November vier Menschen in der Region Donezk getötet.

items.title: Part of Putin's diesel tankers turn around and head away from the US – FT
items.teaser: Course changes by Russian diesel tankers threaten to worsen US fuel supply shortages as state officials and Congress warn against receiving sanctioned shipments.

items.title: Poland detains six suspects accused of working for Russian intelligence and supplying military materials
items.teaser: Poland's Internal Security Agency has detained five Poles and a Russian woman accused of spying for Russia and illegally supplying materials for ammunition production.

items.title: Zuerst überflog ein US-Spionageflugzeug den Suwalki-Korridor, danach umkreiste es die russische Exklave Kaliningrad
items.teaser: Ein US-Aufklärungsflugzeug hat erneut eine Mission nahe Kaliningrad geflogen. Die Artemis II überquerte dabei zweimal den Suwałki-Korridor.

items.title: Violation of the Duty of Disclosure as a Ground for Challenging an Arbitrator Under Georgian Arbitration Law
items.teaser: The independence and impartiality of arbitrators are fundamental guarantees of due process. Arbitration derives its legitimacy not only from party autonomy and procedural flexibility, but also from the parties’ confidence that their dispute will be decided by an impartial and independent tribunal. items.title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure in Chernihiv region
items.teaser: Russian forces continue to target energy infrastructure in Ukraine's Chernihiv region.

items.title: Bodies of 42 people recovered from rubble of school destroyed by Russian strike in Komyshuvakha
items.teaser: The bodies of 42 people have been recovered from the rubble in the village of Komyshuvakha on the fourth day of search and rescue operations. Another 33 people may still be trapped under the rubble.

items.title: Kälte, Knappheit und Sabotage: Europas Energie im Stresstest
items.teaser: Der kommende Winter wird für Europa keine „Katastrophe mit Datum“, sondern eine Belastungsprobe für ein bereits sehr angespanntes System.

items.title: Russian forces shell Marhanets, four injured
items.teaser: Russian forces launched an artillery strike on the city of Marhanets in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region, injuring four people.

items.title: Germany’s chancellor admits occasional resupply snags in Ukraine aid—he’ll try to clear them at the 19 November summit
items.teaser: Merz said he gathered from the talks that deliveries, F-16 ammunition in particular, are helping Ukraine’s army a lot right now.

items.title: Ryazan under massive drone attack: Fire breaks out at one of Russia's largest oil refineries, Wildberries warehouse
items.teaser: A local oil refinery in the Russian city of Ryazan, which supplies aviation fuel and diesel to the Russian military, caught fire following a drone attack.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 105 feindliche Drohnen

items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj verlieh der First Lady der USA, Melania Trump, den Orden der Fürstin Olga, 1. Klasse.

items.title: Zelensky instructs government, law enforcement to speed up repairs and ensure electricity, heating, and water supplies
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky has instructed the government and law enforcement agencies to present a list of measures by the end of the day to ensure that people have access to electricity, heating, and water.

items.title: Stable water supply restored in Kyiv
items.teaser: Kyivvodokanal says all water supply and sewage pumping stations are working normally and network pressure is stable after Russian strikes caused power outages.

items.title: NATO prepares new defence plan foreseeing strikes deep inside Russian territory – WSJ
items.teaser: Guided by Commander Alexus Grynkewich's "theory of victory," NATO plans deep conventional strikes to dismantle Russian supply lines during a potential conflict.

items.title: Ukrainian Caucus co-chair in U.S. Congress Marcy Kaptur reelected to another term
items.teaser: Democratic Congresswoman and co-chair of the Ukrainian Caucus in the U.S. Congress Marcy Kaptur has been reelected to the House of Representatives following the midterm elections held on November 3.

items.title: Ukraine and European Commission in talks on Drone Deal
items.teaser: Ukraine seeks a formal Drone Deal with the European Commission to build joint defence-industrial capacity and enhance regional security partnerships

items.title: 'Insane attack' — Death toll from Russian attack on Komyshuvakha rises to 40 as search operation enters 3rd day
items.teaser: More than 30 people may still be trapped under the rubble, President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

items.title: EU says Ukraine must speed up rule of law reforms to meet accession goals
items.teaser: The EU has committed to supporting Ukraine's goal of closing accession talks by the end of 2028, but says reforms must accelerate to meet that objective.

items.title: Moldova outpaces Ukraine on new EU membership roadmap
items.teaser: Ukraine and Moldova are both expected to make strides toward EU membership next year, even as Chisinau outpaces Kyiv on reforms.

items.title: Russian forces strike food production facility in Zlatopil, Kharkiv region
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a food production facility in Zlatopil, Kharkiv region, on November 4. Products were destroyed, equipment was damaged, and a large-scale fire broke out.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 6, injure 50 across Ukraine over past day, as energy facilities targeted in multiple regions
items.teaser: Russian forces continued to target the energy infrastructure of Ukraine over the past day, including Odesa, Kirovohrad, Zhytomyr, western Ternopil, Volyn, and Rivne oblasts, the local authorities said on Oct. 4.

items.title: Ukrainian nuclear power plants have been forced to reduce electricity generation, Energy Ministry says
items.teaser: Ukraine's Energy Ministry says nuclear plants have reduced output because attacks on substations are limiting electricity distribution; the Kyiv region is the worst affected.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike two Russian Pantsir air defense systems in Crimea
items.teaser: Units of the Ukrainian Defense Forces have struck two Russian Pantsir surface-to-air missile and gun systems and a firing unit in temporarily occupied Crimea.

items.title: Ukrainska Pravda obtains footage of searches at SSU general's home
items.teaser: Ukrainska Pravda has obtained photos and videos of NABU searches at the home of SSU General Serhii Duka, who allegedly threatened detectives with a firearm.

items.title: Russische Angriffe zwingen Kernkraftwerke zu Leistungsdrosselung
items.teaser: Aufgrund der russischen Angriffe sind die Kernkraftwerke gezwungen, ihre Leistung zu drosseln.

items.title: China's Foreign Ministry confirms talks with US and Russia on three-leader summit – Bloomberg
items.teaser: China's Foreign Ministry says it is in contact with Washington and Moscow about a possible Xi-Trump-Putin meeting at the APEC summit in Shenzhen on 18-19 November.

items.title: Nuclear power plants forced to reduce output after Russian attacks – Energy Ministry
items.teaser: Ukraine's nuclear power plants have been forced to reduce electricity generation due to the impact of large-scale Russian attacks on energy infrastructure.

items.title: NABU and SAPO complete pre-trial investigation in Midas case
items.teaser: The National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) and the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office (SAPO) have completed the pre-trial investigation into a large-scale corruption scheme in the energy sector.

items.title: First Among Equals: The Election for the ICJ’s Presidency
items.teaser: Congratulations to Rena Lee, François Alabrune, Dapo Akande, Mahmoud Hmoud, and Phoebe Okowa on their election to the International Court of Justice (ICJ)! items.title: Death toll in Komyshuvakha rises to 37 as search operations continue
items.teaser: Emergency and rescue operations have been underway in Komyshuvakha for a third consecutive day. The death toll has risen to 37. Another 59 people are listed as missing, while 38 more may still be trapped under the rubble.

items.title: A three-ton bomb fell on an aid queue on Monday—two days later, rescuers have found 37 dead. And now Russia strikes Ukraine’s power stations
items.teaser: Dozens are still missing in Komyshuvakha while Russian drones and missiles keep hitting energy sites, and three were sent at a substation a nuclear plant depends on.

items.title: Komyschuwacha: Zahl der Todesopfer auf 40 gestiegen – Sucharbeiten dauern an
items.teaser: In Komyschuwacha dauern die Rettungsmaßnahmen bereits den dritten Tag an.

items.title: Ukraine, EU enlargement and energy to top agenda of Visegrad Four summit
items.teaser: Ukraine, European Union enlargement and energy will be the main topics of the Visegrad Four summit, which will be held in Trenčín, Slovakia, on November 4-5.

items.title: Russen töten zwei Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Die russischen Angreifer haben am 3. November zwei Menschen in der Region Donezk getötet.

items.title: And still, they plant: Ukraine's front-line farmers rebuild their businesses against all odds
items.teaser: Russian forces have repeatedly struck the dairy farm of 70-year-old Volodymyr Starychenko in Krolevets, Sumy Oblast, since the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion. items.title: Debris from Russian drones falls in Kyiv's Sviatoshynskyi, Holosiivskyi districts, fires break out
items.teaser: Debris from Russian drones has been reported in Kyiv's Sviatoshynskyi and Holosiivskyi districts, causing fires.

items.title: Zhovkva: Ukraine's EU membership must be integral part of peace agreements
items.teaser: Ukraine's membership in the European Union must become one of the fundamental elements of its security guarantees and an integral part of any future peace agreements.

items.title: An online-retail hub in Russia and a Russian-run phone network in occupied Donetsk: two of one night’s targets
items.teaser: One strike went after the warehouses that supply Russian shoppers, the other after the communications that serve the occupation.

items.title: Zelensky awards Melania Trump Order of Princess Olga
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has awarded U.S. First Lady Melania Trump the Order of Princess Olga, 1st Class, for her significant contribution to humanitarian support for Ukraine.

items.title: Drohnen treffen Ozon-Logistikzentrum in russischer Region Adygeja
items.teaser: In der Stadt Adygeisk in der russischen Republik Adygeja wurde infolge eines Drohnenangriffs ein Logistikzentrum des Online-Marktplatzes Ozon beschädigt.

items.title: Russian forces attack Vilniansk with drones, killing two
items.teaser: Russian troops have struck the city of Vilniansk in the Zaporizhzhia region, killing two people and injuring another.

items.title: Ukraine's anti-graft agencies probe possible SBU role in high-profile case, report firearm threats during searches
items.teaser: NABU and SAPO said they had uncovered a criminal organization accused of "systematically bribing" senior law enforcement officials to secure protection for scam call centers and other illegal businesses.

items.title: Zelensky awards Melania Trump Ukraine's Order of Princess Olga for humanitarian work
items.teaser: The decree credited Melania Trump with a "significant personal contribution to humanitarian support for Ukraine."

items.teaser: As starkly illustrated by a string of recent UK High Court decisions, international arbitration is expensive ( see GEMBBL v Kurdistan and Safra v Wilmer Hale ). items.title: Drones hit Ozon logistics center in Russia's Adygea – media
items.teaser: A logistics center belonging to the Ozon online marketplace was damaged in a drone attack in the city of Adygeysk in Russia's Republic of Adygea.

items.title: Two killed in Russian attack on Vilniansk in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, fire breaks out in apartment building
items.teaser: Russian forces launched two strikes on Vilniansk in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, killing two people and injuring a man.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 272 von 310 feindlichen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 272 von 310 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 3. November das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Zelenskyy awards Order of Princess Olha to Melania Trump
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has conferred the Order of Princess Olha, 1st Class, on US First Lady Melania Trump.

items.title: Ukraine's Operation Carthage: NABU, SAPO expose bribery scheme involving senior officials
items.teaser: The National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) and the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office (SAPO) have exposed a scheme involving the payment of bribes to senior law enforcement officials in exchange for allowing fraudulent call centers and other illegal businesses to operate unhindered.

items.title: Russia's 3 November attack on Dnipro: 14 remain in hospital, 4 in serious condition
items.teaser: Fourteen people injured in the Russian attack on Dnipro on 3 November remain in hospital, four of them in a serious condition.

items.title: US Congress turns blue, Trump keeps the veto—and Ukraine’s balance sheet in Washington gets both wins and losses
items.teaser: Voters removed some of the Kremlin’s favorite voices on Capitol Hill, but also some of the Republicans who fought hardest for Kyiv.

items.title: Russia attacks energy infrastructure in six Ukrainian oblasts
items.teaser: Russia attacked energy infrastructure in Ternopil, Kirovohrad, Rivne, Volyn, Odesa and Zhytomyr oblasts on the evening of 3 November and overnight into 4 November.

items.title: Ukraine hopes to begin closing EU accession negotiation chapters in early 2027
items.teaser: Presidential Office official Ihor Zhovkva has confirmed Ukraine plans to begin closing negotiating chapters in early 2027, aiming to complete most by year-end.

items.title: Search and rescue operation in Komyshuvakha: 38 more people may be trapped under rubble, 59 remain missing
items.teaser: The bodies of 31 people killed in a Russian airstrike have been recovered from the rubble in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. The identities of 12 victims have been established.

items.title: In Region Cherson drei Zivilisten verletzt, 40 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 40 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurden drei Zivilisten verletzt.

items.title: Spionage-Alarm? - City-Trainer schickte eine WhatsApp nach Leipzig
items.teaser: RB-Leipzig-Trainer Martin Demichelis und City-Kollege Enzo Maresca sind „wie Brüder“.

items.title: Ukraine's Anti-Corruption Bureau completes investigation into high-profile Midas case
items.teaser: NABU and SAPO have completed their investigation into the Midas corruption scheme involving Energoatom officials and businessman Tymur Mindich, uncovering over US$111 million and €12 million in cash.

items.title: Drone debris falls in two Kyiv districts
items.teaser: Fires have broken out on a house roof in the Sviatoshynskyi district and in an open area in the Holosiivskyi district when debris from downed Russian UAVs landed in the capital.

items.title: Air defense neutralizes 272 of 310 drones launched by Russia against Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 272 of the 310 drones used by Russian invaders to attack Ukraine since the evening of November 3.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,597,010 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,180 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 208 Gefechte an der Front, Mehrheit davon Richtung Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: Am 3. November kam es zu 208 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: War update: 208 clashes on front lines over past day, heaviest fighting on Kostiantynivka axis
items.teaser: A total of 208 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on November 3.

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff reports 208 combat clashes over past day, including 24 on Kostiantynivka front
items.teaser: Ukraine’s General Staff reports 208 combat clashes on 3 November, with 24 Russian attacks on the Kostiantynivka front and 15 on the Pokrovsk front.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure in Kirovohrad region overnight
items.teaser: On the night of November 4, Russian drones attacked energy infrastructure in the Kirovohrad region.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 2180 weiteren Angreifern
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 4. November 2026 bei rund 1.597.010 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 2.180 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Russia loses another 2,180 troops in war against Ukraine in past 24 hours
items.teaser: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine—from February 24, 2022, to November 4, 2026—amount to approximately 1,597,010 people, including 2,180 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Künstlerin aus Zwickau gestaltet Video zur NSU-Aufarbeitung
items.teaser: Die Videokünstlerin Lysann König hat mit Menschen aus Zwickau über den NSU-Terror und dessen Folgen gesprochen. Ihr gut einstündiger Film beschäftigt sich mit Erinnerung, Aufarbeitung und dem Gedenken der Opfer.

items.title: Drone attack debris falls near private home in Kyiv’s Desnianskyi district
items.teaser: In Kyiv’s Desnianskyi District, debris fell on an open area near a private home.

items.title: Democrats seize control of Congress in blow to Trump, potential boost for Ukraine
items.teaser: The Associated Press projected that Democrats had won control of the Senate, while NBC News projected a Democratic victory in the House of Representatives. Vote counting remained underway in several congressional races.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with more than 300 drones overnight
items.teaser: Russia launched 310 attack drones against Ukraine overnight. More than 20 drones were still in Ukrainian airspace as of 08:00.

items.title: Pierce Brosnan schwärmt von Bond-Kandidat Callum Turner
items.teaser: Ex-007 Pierce Brosnan wartet wie der Rest der Welt darauf, dass endlich der neue James Bond vorgestellt wird. Für ihn wäre Callum Turner eine gute Wahl, er gönnt es aber auch den anderen Stars im Rennen um die Agentenrolle.

items.title: Russian attack on business in Dnipro injures two people
items.teaser: Two people were injured as a result of a strike on a factory in Dnipro; a fire has broken out at the facility.

items.title: Trump comes up with an excuse for his party's election defeat
items.teaser: Donald Trump has blamed his absence from the ballot for the Republican Party's poor performance in the US midterm elections, claiming his presence would have secured a landslide victory.

items.title: Russian drone strikes private company premises in Poltava
items.teaser: During an airstrike, a Russian drone struck the premises of a private company in Poltava.

items.title: Russian drone hits energy facility in Ternopil Oblast
items.teaser: An energy infrastructure facility in Ternopil Oblast has been damaged in a Russian drone strike.

items.title: Russia loses 2,180 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,180 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Two injured in Russian strike on business in Dnipro
items.teaser: Two men aged 38 and 57 have been taken to hospital with shrapnel wounds after a Russian strike sparked a fire at a business in Dnipro on 4 November.

items.title: Ukrainian troops strike 30 strategic targets in Russia in October - MoD
items.teaser: In October, units of the Ukrainian Defense Forces struck at least 30 strategic targets on Russian territory, including seven defense industry plants, three military airfields, as well as aircraft, radar systems, and military logistics facilities of the Russian Armed Forces.

items.title: Trump loses majority in the Senate
items.teaser: Early results from the US midterm elections show the Democratic Party has secured the minimum number of seats needed for a Senate majority, while Republicans are also trailing in the House of Representatives.

items.title: Enemy strikes shopping center in Odesa
items.teaser: The enemy struck a shopping center in Odesa, causing a fire.
